{{Top|fa|italics2=1}} {{Otheruses|unidentified moon}} {{CelestialBody |image=[[File:UnidentifiedMoon-VaD.png]] |name=Unidentified moon |region= |sector= |system= |coordinates= |xyz= |distance= |suns= |orbited= |position= |moons= |routes= |lengthday= |lengthyear= |class=Terrestrial{{TCW|Victory and Death}} |diameter= |atmosphere=[[Atmosphere|Type I]] {{C|breathable}}{{TCW|Victory and Death}} establishes that the [[moon]] had a breathable [[atmosphere]] that {{BuildFalconCite|43|Secrets of Spaceflight}} classifies as Type I. |climate=[[Temperature|Arctic]] |gravity= |terrain=Rocky |water= |interest=''[[Tribunal]]'' wreckage |flora= |fauna= |otherlife= |species= |otherspecies= |socialgroup= |language= |government= |population= |demonym= |cities= |imports= |exports= |affiliation= }} {{Quote|We're caught in that moon's gravitational field.|Rex, to Ahsoka Tano|audio=RexMoonGravitationalField.flac|}} An [[Temperature|arctic]] and [[Stone|rocky]] '''unidentified moon''' was located in [[the galaxy]]. Shortly after the initiation of [[Order 66]] in [[19 BBY]], the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Tribunal]]'', which had been carrying former [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano]], fell out of [[hyperspace]] above the [[moon]] after the former [[Sith apprentice]] [[Maul]], previously a [[prisoner]] on the [[Starship|vessel]], destroyed its [[hyperdrive]]. Caught in the moon's [[Gravity|gravitational]] field, the [[Star Destroyer]] was set on a collision course. Tano and [[Clone Commander]] [[Rex]] managed to [[Skirmish aboard the Tribunal|escape]] before the starship crashed, but the remaining [[clone trooper]]s aboard were [[Death|killed]]. Around [[17 BBY]], during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], [[Imperial Military|Imperial forces]] led by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] visited the crash site of the ''Tribunal'', where Vader discovered the abandoned [[Ahsoka Tano's lightsabers|lightsaber]] of his former apprentice. ==Description== {{Quote|We've entered the atmosphere. Fire retrorockets!''"
"''We've lost lateral control! We're gonna break apart!|Two Republic officers, during the crash of the ''Tribunal''|audio=FireRetrorockets-VaD.flac|}} [[File:Venator_crashes_Order_66.png|thumb|left|275px|The moon as it appeared from space.]] Although it lacked a name,{{Topps|set=2021 Topps Star Wars Chrome Legacy|cardname=Darth Vader finds Ahsoka Tano's Lightsaber|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/269175/cid/17369321/2021-Topps-Chrome-Star-Wars-Legacy-113-Darth-Vader-Finds-Ahsoka-Tano's-Lightsaber|nobackup=1}} an [[Temperature|arctic]],[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Collector's Edition|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' – The Official Collector's Edition]] remote,''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' and [[Stone|rocky]] [[moon]] was situated in [[the galaxy]] somewhere between the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] [[planet]] [[Mandalore]] and the [[Core Worlds]] planet [[Coruscant]],''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' places the [[planet]]s [[Mandalore]] and [[Coruscant]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories]] and [[Core Worlds]], respectively. "[[Shattered]]" establishes that the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Tribunal]]'', shown departing the [[Mandalore system]], is en route to Coruscant prior to being thrown into chaos by the issuing of [[Order 66]]. "[[Victory and Death]]" subsequently shows the [[starship]] crashing into the [[moon]] after falling out of [[hyperspace]], indicating it must be somewhere along a route between Mandalore and Coruscant. near a larger [[Color|blue]]-and-white astronomical object. It appeared brown with some green patches visible from [[Realspace|space]] along with white [[cloud]]s, and had a Type I [[atmosphere]] breathable to [[human]]s and [[Togruta]]s. Its climate was frigid, with the barren area where the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Tribunal]]''''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Character Encyclopedia - Join the Battle!]]'' crashed at the end of the [[Clone Wars]]—a three-[[Standard year|year]] conflict between the [[Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]—becoming covered in [[Water|snow]] by the [[time]] the crash site was discovered by the [[Galactic Empire]] some years later.{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/victory-and-death-episode-guide|text="Victory and Death" Episode Guide - The Clone Wars}} ==History== ===Order 66=== {{Quote|We need to get out of here.|Ahsoka Tano, upon seeing the moon approaching through the ''Tribunal''{{'s}} hangar doors|audio=WeNeedToGetOutOfHere-VaD.flac|}} [[File:TribunalCrashing-VaD.png|thumb|right|300px|The ''Tribunal'' careens towards the moon.]] In [[19 BBY]],{{TCWcanondates|712}} the ''Venator''-class [[Star Destroyer]] ''Tribunal'' traveled through [[hyperspace]] from Mandalore to Coruscant, commanded by the former [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano]]. Having captured the renegade [[Sith Lord]] [[Maul]], a former [[Sith apprentice|apprentice]] of{{TCW|Shattered}} [[Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Sidious]], during the [[Siege of Mandalore]], she and [[Clone Commander]] [[Rex]] intended to deliver him to the [[Jedi High Council]]. However, during their journey, Sidious issued [[Order 66]], a [[Executive Order Codes for the Grand Army of the Republic|secret directive]] which compelled the [[clone trooper]]s of the [[Grand Army of the Republic]] to turn on and [[Death penalty|execute]] their Jedi [[Commanding officer|commanders]] via [[Behavioral modification biochip|inhibitor chips]] implanted in their [[brain]]s. Thus, the [[trooper]]s aboard the ''Tribunal'' [[Skirmish aboard the Tribunal|attacked]] Tano after receiving the order. Tano narrowly escaped the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] and reluctantly released Maul from the [[Mandalorian vault]] he had been [[Prisoner|imprisoned]] in as a diversion for the [[Cloning|clones]]. Left to his own devices, Maul destroyed the [[starship]]'s [[hyperdrive]], severely damaging it and forcing it out of hyperspace, where it was caught in the moon's [[Gravity|gravitational pull]] and set on a collision course. Meanwhile, Tano used the distraction to follow up on a clue Rex had given her, capturing him in order to remove his inhibitor chip and bring him back to his senses. As the ''Tribunal'' fell, Tano and Rex reached the [[hangar]] control room and discovered the situation the ship was in. However, as they were fighting their way to a [[Nu-class attack/transport shuttle|''Nu''-class shuttle]] to escape, Maul seized the craft for himself. Tano attempted to prevent Maul from leaving, but chose to let him go in order to defend Rex from [[332nd Division|clone reinforcements]] that had arrived. [[File:AhsokaSkydiving-VaD.png|thumb|left|300px|Ahsoka Tano falls through the moon's atmosphere]] As the ''Tribunal'' hit the moon's atmosphere and began to fall apart, Tano and Rex found a [[Rex's BTL-B Y-wing fighter-bomber|working]] [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/bomber|Y-wing]] in the repair bay to escape in. [[Force power|Using]] [[the Force]], Tano [[Telekinesis|threw]] Rex over to the [[BTL Y-wing starfighter|starfighter]] while holding off more attacking clones. As the bridge exploded, the ship was thrown completely out of control, causing it to plummet more rapidly towards the moon. Rex entered the [[Starfighter|Y-wing]] and shouted for Tano to join him, but the Y-wing was knocked free of the ''Tribunal'' as Tano leapt for it, sending her tumbling through the atmosphere. Rex gained control of the starfighter after some difficulty and flew back for her, with Tano dashing across falling debris to reach him. When the ''Tribunal'' crashed, everyone onboard was [[Death|killed]] and a gouge was torn into the lunar surface. ===The crash site=== {{Quote|Ahsoka and I barely managed to survive the chaos ourselves. As much as I wanted to save our squad, it was too late. Like the good soldiers they had always been, they followed their final order…right into an early grave.|Rex, ''The Secrets of the Clone Troopers''|''[[Star Wars: The Secrets of the Clone Troopers]]''}} Afterward, Tano and Rex landed at the crash site, salvaging useful items from the wreckage, including the remains of Tano's [[astromech droid]] [[R7-A7]], who had been taken out by [[blaster]] fire during the hangar firefight. To honor their comrades, they [[Burial|buried]] the bodies of every clone trooper they could find in a makeshift graveyard, marking the graves with the clones' [[helmet]]s on sticks. Despairing, Tano abandoned her [[Ahsoka Tano's lightsabers|lightsabers]]{{Databank|ahsoka-tano|Ahsoka Tano}} at the crash site in order to fake her death.[[Ahsoka (novel)|''Ahsoka'']] After leaving the moon, Tano and Rex eventually parted ways in order to hide,{{TOTJ|Resolve (episode)}} leaving the repaired R7 with the [[Martez family|Martez sisters]], two [[smuggler]]s{{TBB|Decommissioned}} who were friends of Tano{{TCW|Together Again}} and who later worked with Rex in efforts against the [[Proclamation of the New Order|newly formed]] Galactic Empire. [[File:Ahsoka_Venator_wreckage.png|thumb|right|300px|The snow-covered wreckage of the ''Tribunal'']] Around [[17 BBY]], during the [[Imperial Era]], the crash site, by then covered in snow, was discovered by [[Imperial Military|Imperial forces]]. In an effort to explore the destroyed [[cruiser]], [[stormtrooper]]s and [[snowtrooper]]s inspected the wreckage with [[Viper probe droid]]s. All of the grave markers erected by Tano and Rex had since fallen down, with the graves themselves hidden by the snow. The Sith Lord [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]], who had been Tano's Master prior to her departure from the [[Jedi Order]] and his fall to the [[Dark side of the Force|dark side]], visited the crash site and recovered one of her abandoned [[lightsaber]]s. After finding and igniting the [[weapon]], Vader saw the [[convor]] [[Morai]], a mystical creature{{Rebels|A World Between Worlds}} who watched over Tano and lingered in places important to her, flying above him. He watched the [[bird]] for a moment before leaving with the lightsaber, reclaiming the blade he had once returned to her as Anakin Skywalker.{{Acme|url=products/the-gift-al-abbazia|text=The Gift}} Despite assuming that Tano may be dead after not sensing her presence at the crash site, the visit to the moon, deep down, proved to the Sith Lord that his former apprentice had survived. Rex included a picture of the moon in his [[book]]—''[[The Secrets of the Clone Troopers]]''—which was published at some point following the [[5 ABY]]''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' [[Galactic Concordance|end]] of the [[Galactic Civil War]] between the Republic's successor state, the Empire, and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. In the same section, he discussed the end of the Clone Wars and his escape with Tano to the moon. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:VaD_Venator_Concept.jpg|thumb|left|275px|Molly Denmark's concept art of the ''Tribunal'' hurtling into the moon.]] The moon first appeared in "[[Victory and Death]]," the series finale of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' animated television series that premiered on [[Disney+]] on [[May 4]], [[2020]]{{DisneyPlus|subdomain=press|url=news/next-on-disney-plus-may-2020|text=Next on Disney+: May 2020}} as part of the show's [[The Clone Wars: Season Seven|seventh season]].{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-clone-wars-returns-on-disney-february-21|text=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Returns on Disney+ February 21}} Two pieces of concept art featuring the moon were done by [[Molly Denmark]].{{SW|url=victory-and-death-concept-art-gallery|text="Victory and Death" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slide 4}}{{SW|url=victory-and-death-concept-art-gallery|text="Victory and Death" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slide 5}} Rex's [[Databank (2014-)|Databank]] entry on [[StarWars.com]] states that the moon was small,{{Databank|clone-captain-rex|Clone Captain Rex}} while Tano's entry states that the moon was large. This article does not assume the correctness of either claim. The card "Darth Vader finds Ahsoka Tano's Lightsaber" from the [[2021 Topps Star Wars Chrome Legacy|2021 Topps ''Star Wars'' Chrome Legacy]] card set established that the moon was not identified [[in-universe]]. The card also states that Vader took both of Tano's lightsabers with him from the moon. However, "Victory and Death" shows that Vader only found and departed with one of the blades.
